author: New China TV
description: Mao Yuanxiang, 25, returned to his hometown in east China's Jiangxi Province to continue his family's beekeeping tradition. Today, as both a new-generation beekeeper and a Party secretary, he's helping transform his community one hive at a time.
title: New-generation beekeeper brings new buzz to rural Jiangxi

author: New China TV
description:
When 23-year-old Chen Bingjie returned to his rural hometown to work as a village official, he quickly realized that true grassroots impact wasn't about grand projects, but simple acts of love.
By launching a mobile photography initiative to gift left-behind seniors their first real portraits and teaching them to video chat with their distant children, he is beautifully bridging the miles between families.
title: Young village official's care warms rural elders in E China's Fuyang

author: New China TV
description:

#heatwave #PortaSplit #China
title: Chinese products cool down a sweltering Europe

description: U.S. President Donald #Trump joined second lady Usha Vance's podcast to read the children's book "Presidents Play", but veered off script with impromptu jabs at his predecessors.
title: Trump reads children's book and goes off script

author: New China TV
description:
2026 marks the 105th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China (CPC).
To better understand the CPC's practices and experiences, Xinhuanet presents "The Path to Success," a series of conversations with political figures from around the world. Through their perspectives, the series explores the CPC's approach to governance and the experiences behind China's transformation.
In this episode, Nguyen Minh Hoan, head of the Faculty of Philosophy Academy of Journalism and Communication at Ho Chi Minh National Academy of Politics  in Vietnam, spoke highly of the brilliant achievements made by China under the leadership of the CPC over the past century. He believed that the CPC's theoretical  explorations and innovations provide important inspiration for Vietnam's development.
title: CPC's success inspires Vietnam: HCMA scholar

author: New China TV
description: In Jingdezhen, the world's porcelain capital, millions of ancient porcelain shards are being transformed into a "gene bank" that helps researchers authenticate artifacts, study ancient society, and preserve the legacy of Chinese porcelain. #GLOBALink
title: Jingdezhen turns "kiln waste" into hub for global ceramic research

author: New China TV
description: Solar panels turn rocky mountains into power hubs in southwest China's Guizhou. Beneath the panels, herbs and vegetables thrive, maximizing the value of every inch of soil. #SolarPanels  #AmazingChina
title: Solar panels turn mountains into productive land in China's Guizhou

author: New China TV
description:
Rangers in Hoh Xil, SW China's Qinghai, have rescued three baby Tibetan antelopes. Now safe and under care, the little trio are now feeding well and making steady recovery. 
#HohXil #TibetanAntelope #WildlifeRescue #Qinghai #Conservation #WildlifeProtection
title: Rangers rescue 3 vulnerable Tibetan antelope calves in Hoh Xil

author: New China TV
description: This year marks the 10th anniversary of the unified China-Europe Railway Express brand. Today, freight trains connect 129 Chinese cities with 236 cities across 26 European countries. Join #Xinhua Live at Tuanjiecun Railway Station, the starting point of the very first China-Europe freight train, to see how this rail corridor has reshaped the station and the cities along its route over the past decade. (recorded)
title: LIVE: How One Rail Route Is Reshaping Trade Between China and Europe

author: New China TV
description:
Every summer, thousands of herders in north China's Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region embark on a centuries-old journey, guiding more than 120,000 head of livestock across the vast grasslands in step with the changing seasons.
Join Xinhua on this ancient route to explore the UNESCO-recognized Ar Horqin Grassland Nomadic System and discover how new generations continue to use traditional ecological wisdom to sustain one of the world's great grassland ecosystems while embracing modern life. (recorded)
title: On the move with Inner Mongolia's nomadic herders

author: New China TV
description: A piggy sculpture from a local shop was swept away by rain-triggered floodwater in Jingdezhen, east China's Jiangxi. Luckily, a passerby stopped it and helped bring "Piggy" back home. #Jingdezhen #Jiangxi #China #piggysculpture #adventure
title: Pig-shaped sculpture drifting in floodwater returned to owner in Jingdezhen

title: Xinhua News | Venezuela quake death toll rises to 2,645
